استرثن (form X)
# اِسْتَرَثْنَ (istaraṯna) /is.ta.raθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
# اُسْتُرِثْنَ (usturiṯna) /us.tu.riθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
# اِسْتَرِثْنَ (istariṯna) /is.ta.riθ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
